description: Modern GPUs can verify 5e11 numbers/sec for Collatz convergence. Combining the modular sieve with GPU parallelism enables delay record searches orders of magnitude faster than distributed CPU projects.
mathematical_formalization: Throughput T = N_threads * IPC * clock / steps_per_number. On RTX 4090: ~4e10 effective numbers/sec after sieve elimination.
implementation_hypothesis: Port sieve to CUDA. Each thread handles one surviving residue class. Shared memory for lookup table. AtomicMax for delay records.
experiment_seed: Benchmark on RTX 3090/4090 vs Intel i9 for delay records in [10^15, 10^16]. Target: 10x speedup.
